items.title_en: Study Shows Kernel Machines Vulnerable to Adversarial Attacks
summary_en: This research examines how well kernel machines handle adversarial examples in machine learning.
The paper compares different models and proposes a new method to improve their robustness against attacks.
key_points_en: Kernel machines' vulnerability to adversarial attacks is analyzed
White-box and black-box attack methods are tested
New algorithm for adversarial training is introduced
translation_zh: 这项研究检查了核机器在机器学习中如何应对对抗性示例
论文比较了不同模型并提出了一种新方法来提高其抗攻击能力

items.title_en: Agentic Evolution: The Key to Adapting Large Language Models
summary_en: As LLMs move into real-world environments, static training can't keep up with changing conditions
Current adaptation methods lack the ability to make lasting improvements
Agentic evolution offers a new way to bridge the training-deployment gap
key_points_en: Static training fails in dynamic environments
Existing methods lack strategic problem-solving
Agentic evolution enables self-improving systems
translation_zh: 随着大语言模型进入现实环境，静态训练无法适应变化条件
现有方法缺乏解决问题的策略性
智能进化使系统能够自我改进

vocab.zh: 不随环境变化的训练方式
训练与部署环境的差异

summary_en: A new AI system called MIND helps scientists test material hypotheses automatically. It uses machine learning to refine ideas, run experiments, and validate results through debate.
The system combines text-based reasoning with computer simulations to speed up scientific discovery in materials science.
key_points_en: MIND uses AI to refine scientific hypotheses
It performs experiments using machine learning models
The system validates results through automated debate
translation_zh: 新的人工智能系统MIND帮助科学家自动测试材料假设。它利用机器学习来完善想法、进行实验并通过辩论验证结果。
该系统结合文本推理和计算机模拟，加速材料科学的发现过程。

items.title_en: Neocloud IREN Delays $4 Billion in Annual Revenue Due to Customer Requests
summary_en: Neocloud IREN is delaying $4 billion in annual revenue from 2026 to early next year because of customer requests.
The company's stock price dropped sharply after announcing the delay.
key_points_en: $4 billion in revenue delayed until early next year
Stock price plunged after the announcement
Customer requests caused the delay
translation_zh: Neocloud IREN 因客户要求将 2026 年的 40 亿美元年收入推迟到明年年初。
公司在宣布延迟后股价大幅下跌。

items.title_en: Democratic election win prompts market rethink on interest rates
summary_en: The article says that a Democratic victory might lead to changes in how interest rates are set.
Factors like resolving the Iran conflict, slower US growth, and new economic policies could influence rate hikes, but nothing is certain yet.
key_points_en: Democratic sweep may change interest rate strategies
Iran resolution and US growth affect rate hikes
New fiscal policies could impact rates, but outcomes are uncertain
translation_zh: 这篇文章指出，民主党在选举中的胜利可能导致市场重新考虑利率的设定方式。
文章提到，解决伊朗冲突、美国经济增长放缓以及新的经济政策可能会影响加息，但结果尚不确定。

items.title_en: AI Trade Outlook and Investor Strategies According to CNBC Experts
summary_en: A recent election result is influencing technology investments, according to CNBC analysts.
Experts suggest investors should reassess AI-related opportunities amid changing market conditions.
The article explores whether the AI investment trend will continue or slow down.
key_points_en: Election outcomes affect tech investment calculations
AI trade dynamics are under review by financial experts
Investors need updated strategies for AI markets
translation_zh: 最近的选举结果正在影响科技投资，CNBC分析师表示。
专家建议投资者应重新评估人工智能相关的机遇，因为市场状况正在变化。
文章探讨了人工智能投资趋势是否会继续或放缓。

items.title_en: Palo Alto Networks Considering $500M Acquisition of AI Security Startup Clutch
summary_en: Palo Alto Networks is discussing a $500 million purchase of Clutch, an AI security company. Clutch, previously valued at $85 million, has investors including Lightspeed and SignalFire.
The potential deal highlights growing interest in AI-driven cybersecurity solutions.
key_points_en: Palo Alto Networks may buy Clutch for $500 million
Clutch was last valued at $85 million
Lightspeed and SignalFire invested in Clutch
translation_zh: 帕洛阿尔托网络公司正在讨论以5亿美元收购人工智能安全公司Clutch。Clutch此前估值为8500万美元，投资者包括Lightspeed和SignalFire。
这笔潜在交易凸显了人们对人工智能驱动的网络安全解决方案日益增长的兴趣。

items.title_en: Harbinger Secures $240M Funding Expansion into Defense Sector
summary_en: Harbinger, a Los Angeles-based startup, has raised over $650 million in total funding.
The company is now developing electric trucks, emergency vehicles, and a driverless platform for military use.
key_points_en: Raised over $650 million in total funding
Developing electric and emergency vehicles
Creating a driverless platform for military use
translation_zh: Harbinger是一家位于洛杉矶的初创公司，已累计筹集超过6.5亿美元的资金。
该公司目前正在开发电动卡车、应急车辆以及用于军事用途的无人驾驶平台。

items.title_en: At least 10 local governments have removed Flock’s surveillance cameras since summer
summary_en: At least 10 local governments have stopped using Flock’s surveillance cameras since summer.
Concerns include privacy issues, unclear data sharing practices, and problems with how the cameras were purchased.
key_points_en: 10+ local governments removed Flock cameras
Privacy and data sharing concerns raised
Procurement process questioned
translation_zh: 至少有10个地方政府自夏季以来停止使用Flock的监控摄像头。
担忧包括隐私问题、数据共享的不明确做法以及摄像头采购过程的问题。
